clues.text: As he talked on and on, a young man named Eutychus fell asleep in a window and fell from the third story.
Festus shouted during his defense that his great learning was driving him to madness.
Nearing Damascus, he saw a light from heaven flash around him and heard a voice ask why he persecuted Him.
When a Roman commander said he paid a high price for his citizenship, this man replied that he was born a citizen.
Standing in the meeting of the Areopagus, he told the men of Athens they were very religious in every way.
During the night he had a vision of a man of Macedonia pleading with him to come over and help.
Closing a letter to a church, he wrote that a greeting in his own hand was his mark in every letter.
